definitions.gloss: until now, so far, up to this point
definitions.explanation: Refers to the entire period from some past time up to the present moment. Used to describe what has been the case or what has happened during that time.

examples.english: What have you been doing until now?

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まで⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I've never eaten food this delicious before.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まで⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かして→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to put my experience up to now to use and take on a new job.

notes:
{今|いま}まで refers to the entire period from some point in the past up to the present. It often appears in sentences about cumulative experience or ongoing states.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can function as an adverb ({今|いま}まで⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ — I've been waiting until now) or as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({今|いま}まで⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ — experience up to now).
- {今|いま}まで〜たこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: have never ~ until now
- {今|いま}まで⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: ~ up to now, previous ~
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り: as before, same as always
- {今|いま}までにない: unprecedented

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until now (slightly more formal, often written)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧: for now, so far (focuses on the current situation)
- ⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧: up to now, conventional (formal/written)
